body:
Sitting at the kitchen table with my buddies Jack and James I asked if I could hit their pipe... They said sure... They were older than I and my brain wasn't fully developed... no blame to them, it's just that the telepathic communication ability comes with age and I wasn't completely on board with them yet. They might have telepathed that It was actually DMT, not cannabis (weed), but I didn't get it in time. Ha!
I picked up the pipe and took a long toke, noticing about three fourths of the way through that it tasted like DMT. I knew the taste, not my first rodeo there... I said 'Holy shit, guys... Is this DMT?'
'Holy shit, guys... Is this DMT?'
and they looked up at me innocently, both working on art projects and writings for school, and nodded. 'I'm going to lay down for this' I said and walked over to the bed that was set in the kitchen near the door... A kitchen bed...
I sat down, and then laid down in the bed on my back and looked up at the plain white ceiling. (Great lazer show, right? It could have been so much better.) Then as the psychedelic took affect in my bloodstream and nervous system I began to see shadow like tall beings over my head, reaching around the sides of my field of vision or 'brain screen' and picking at me, prodding and pulling. I laid back and relaxed, used to the strangeness of psychedelia, and as the time passed (not very long, short lasting chemical) came down and tuned my awareness to Jack and James at their table.
They were still working, but now I could hear in my mind their voices talking gently to each other... They were in love, Jaclyn and James (I called her Jack and so did James) and in their voices I heard a presence that I can only describe as ancient. I heard their voices as souls that had existed for millions of years. They sounded old, experienced, kind, gentle, and diligent. I sat up and we talked about how they meant no deceit, they just didn't think to tell me they'd smoked DMT in it prior to me using it, and that they would have been more cautionary had they thought of it. I'm psychic now and also refused by people who do not believe. With that, I am prescribed lithium for hearing voices.
I am prescribed lithium for hearing voices.
This cooccurence comes with a society breaking through the old paradigms and opening up their third eyes. Life.
DMT and alien shadows, lanky and curious... trip out
